request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:FARM

layers.text: Remove all ground and all snow: erase the square slab of earth, grass and snow under the gravestones, with its side walls, so that the gravestones and the dead shrub stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under or between them. Keep every gravestone, the cross, the dead shrub, their slate-grey colours, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
